md: [FIX] Reduced database connection usage so shared databases do not run out of connections: the connection pool is now configurable in `server.ini` with a lower default, Celery beat and workers close the connections they kept open from startup, `faraday-worker` without `--concurrency` now starts at most `celery_max_worker_concurrency` processes (default 2, previously one per CPU core), and each process is identified by `application_name` in PostgreSQL. #8547
